Teacher Mei · 美老師
Nice to meet you 👋

Hi, I'm your child's teacher 你好，我是孩子的老師

For over ten years I've welcomed little ones into a warm, safe room full of books, blocks, and curiosity. We learn through play, sing every morning, and celebrate every small victory together. 十多年來，我用溫暖與耐心陪伴每個孩子。我們在遊戲中學習、每天早晨一起唱歌，也為每一個小小的進步喝采。

Your child will always be greeted with a smile, a hug, and a fresh new adventure. 每天，孩子都會被一個微笑、一個擁抱和全新的冒險迎接。
